title: Make the explanation visible.
promise: Show a reusable voice-to-frame mechanism with progressive typography and a shared camera.

scenes.narration: Start with the voice. The explanation decides which object deserves attention.
scenes.visual: Reveal a circular voice token with masked typography.

scenes.narration: Mark the exact cue. Store it once, on a shared frame timeline.
scenes.visual: Draw a connector to a frame cue.

scenes.narration: Build the relationship. Reveal the next connection while the current label stays readable.
scenes.visual: Move the shared camera slightly as a focus token activates.

scenes.narration: Resolve into one composition. Voice, captions, and motion now share the same timing contract.
scenes.visual: Reveal the complete system and settle into a reading hold.
